purpose: Compact map of software/IT and software-accountability lanes through rev0011: control-plane failures, vulnerability rails, and attribution-trap/machine-testimony records.

rows.label: Knight Capital
rows.failure_surface: automated trading deployment / stale code path

rows.label: Equifax
rows.failure_surface: known vulnerable component plus patch/asset/monitoring gap
rows.visibility_or_control_gap: vulnerability rail did not become verified remediation; monitoring inactive

rows.label: CVE
rows.visibility_or_control_gap: identifier is not mitigation or postmortem

rows.label: NVD
rows.visibility_or_control_gap: repository is not patch compliance or incident investigation

rows.label: CISA KEV
rows.visibility_or_control_gap: exploitation-priority list is not all software failure denominator

rows.label: Therac-25
rows.failure_surface: medical-device control software and misleading internal state
rows.visibility_or_control_gap: operator/patient-facing signals did not reveal decisive overdose/software state

rows.label: Post Office Horizon
rows.failure_surface: branch accounting software used as legal/evidentiary infrastructure
rows.visibility_or_control_gap: subpostmasters lacked equal access to audit/internal state while shortfalls were attributed to them

rows.label: Volkswagen Dieselgate
rows.visibility_or_control_gap: lab test behavior concealed field behavior until in-use/adversarial testing

rows.label: FDA MDR/MAUDE
rows.visibility_or_control_gap: makes reports searchable but not causality/rate denominator

rows.label: Horizon IT Inquiry
rows.visibility_or_control_gap: late public evidence/redress surface, not real-time prevention rail

rows.label: EPA/CARB in-use testing
rows.visibility_or_control_gap: in-use/off-cycle testing exposes software optimized for test scripts

rows.label: software opacity attribution-trap pattern candidate
rows.visibility_or_control_gap: requires negative controls and successful controls before maturation

guardrail: Software failure records must separate vulnerability, outage, breach, accidental safety failure, evidence/legal attribution, and deliberate regulatory evasion. Rev0011 adds machine-testimony/attribution-trap records without claiming a universal theory.
